---
title: "E104: Unbalanced brackets in an edge"
description: "A bracketed edge `-[ … ]->` must close with `]->` on the same line, with balanced brackets inside."
---

<!-- Generated by `delta gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

A bracketed edge `-[ … ]->` must close with `]->` on the same line, with balanced brackets inside.

## Example

```delta error
dfa M {
  start q0
  q0 -[a-> q0
}
```
